title: 기차 예매 앱 읽기: 몇 시 기차, 어떤 좌석이에요?
objective: By the end, you can read a train booking app screen and find the departure and arrival stations and times, the number of people, the class, and whether you can still book.
summary: Learn to read the main words, times, and seat numbers on a Korean train booking app.
note: The app screen on this sheet is a made-up example. Real apps may look a little different.

task.title: Read and find information
task.line: Read each app screen or sentence, then answer, choose, or put the items in order.

steps.en: choose your departure and arrival stations
choose the date and number of people

items.text: This shows where or when the train leaves.
This shows where or when the train gets in.
Choose how many adults (어른) and children (어린이) are going.
Press it to see the list of trains.
This is the normal, cheaper seat.
This seat is bigger and costs more.
Pick your seat on the seat map.
Press it to book that train.
No seats are left, so you cannot press it.
items.example: 이 기차는 매진이에요. 다음 기차를 보세요.

sections.heading: 읽기 팁
paragraphs: Times use the 24-hour clock: 14:05 = 2:05 p.m. On your ticket, 3호차 12A means car 3, seat 12A.
A 매진 button is usually gray. Check both 일반실 and 특실. One may be sold out while the other is still open.

exercises: Look at the screen and answer in Korean: [부산 → 대전 | 11월 3일 | 어른 2명, 어린이 1명] ① 출발역은 어디예요? ② 모두 몇 명이에요?
You want a standard-class seat. Can you book this train? Answer Yes or No and say why: [15:20 출발 → 17:05 도착 | 일반실 매진 | 특실 예매]
Answer in English: ① 승차권: 19:35 출발 — What time does the train leave (a.m. or p.m.)? ② 승차권: 5호차 8D — Which car do you get on?
Choose the right word: ① 기차 시간을 보고 싶어요. (조회 / 결제)를 누르세요. ② 기차표는 카드로 (결제 / 도착)했어요. ③ 조금 비싸도 넓은 자리가 좋아요. (일반실 / 특실)을 골라요.
Put these in the right order: (가) 카드로 결제해요. (나) 창가 좌석을 골라요. (다) 서울에서 광주까지 기차를 조회해요. (라) 앱에서 승차권을 봐요.
answers: No. 일반실 (standard class) is 매진 (sold out). Only 특실 (first class) can be booked.
① 7:35 p.m. ② Car 5 (5호차). Your seat is 8D.
① 조회 ② 결제 ③ 특실
